actions.name: read_file
actions.description: Read the zizmor dist-info INSTALLER file to understand how the package was installed. It contains 'pip', confirming zizmor 1.25.2 was installed via pip into .audit-tools/. This is part of a security audit toolchain update: actionlint (GitHub Actions linter, ELF binary in .audit-bin/) and zizmor 1.25.2 (GitHub Actions security scanner, installed via pip to .audit-tools/) were added or updated in the repo. The 1710-file change count likely reflects the binary blobs and pip-installed package tree being committed.
